symptoms: Job fails only when --user-jars-first is set
Missing field, class or method from a software.amazon.awssdk package
Same JAR worked before the runtime upgrade
likely_causes: A custom JAR supplied with --user-jars-first bundles an AWS SDK for Java 2.x older than the 2.44.6 that AWS Glue 6.0 ships, and --user-jars-first puts the older SDK ahead of the runtime's own
The AWS Glue runtime depends on classes, fields or methods that the bundled SDK does not have
diagnostic_steps: Confirm --user-jars-first is set in the job default_arguments
List the AWS SDK version bundled inside each custom JAR and compare it against 2.44.6
Check whether the JAR needs to shade the SDK at all, or whether it can rely on the runtime's
fixes: Rebuild the custom JAR against AWS SDK for Java 2.x version 2.44.6 or later
Or stop bundling the SDK inside the JAR and let the runtime supply it, removing the need for --user-jars-first
Or remove --user-jars-first if it was set for an unrelated reason and is no longer needed
unsafe_fixes: Keeping --user-jars-first and pinning the runtime to an older Glue version to match the bundled SDK: it postpones the upgrade without recording why
verification: Run the job on AWS Glue 6.0 with --user-jars-first still set and the rebuilt JAR, and confirm the field resolves
rollback: Remove --user-jars-first so the runtime's own SDK wins the classpath, then re-run
